dict.string: Roci uses your microphone to record your side of a meeting and for dictation, and keeps recordings on this Mac.
Roci records the other participants' audio only while you record a meeting, and keeps it on this Mac.
Roci uses Screen & System Audio Recording only to hear the other participants of a meeting when System Audio Recording is unavailable. It never records your screen.
Roci reads your calendar to notify you about upcoming meetings and help identify speakers during transcription.
Roci adds your meeting action items to Reminders and marks them done in Roci when you complete them there.
Roci transcribes your recordings on this Mac with Apple's speech recognition when you choose it as your transcription model.
Roci saves each meeting's summary and transcript as a note in Apple Notes when you turn on the Apple Notes integration.
Roci connects to model servers you run on your network, such as Ollama or llama-server on another computer.
